questions.description: 打印右对齐的星号行。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(1, 4):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for i in range(1, 4):
    print(" " * (3 - i) + "*" * i)

questions.description: 循环输出索引与平方。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(1, 4):
    print(___, i * i)

for i in range(1, 4):
    print(i, i * i)

questions.description: 统计列表中大于平均值的个数。
questions.code_template:
nums = [3, 8, 5, 10]
avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
count = 0
for n in nums:
    if n > avg:
        count += 1
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [3, 8, 5, 10]
avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
count = 0
for n in nums:
    if n > avg:
        count += 1
print(f"Above average: {count}")
